scope: All 210 final selected completed calls; read-only execution, event and recording audit; no new LLM grading

confirmed_defect.cause: Generated matcher references TRUE_WORDS and FALSE_WORDS without defining either constant; its string-to-boolean matching branch raises NameError.
confirmed_defect.impact: Calls continued and completed, but the failed fixture response can affect subsequent behavior and scores. These three calls need the matcher repaired and new runs; current scores are retained as pre-fix evidence.

note: The legacy execution classifier labels all 210 completed calls valid. This independent audit additionally checks tool errors and flags three completed calls with a fixture defect. Audio checks read and hash decoded PCM without modifying recordings. It does not listen to or grade every utterance.
